title_en: [Hanwha Aerospace] Notice of Planned 2026 Academic Year Winter Session Field Practice Semester (English Speaking Test Score Required)
summary: The Department of Aerospace Engineering plans to run a recruitment-linked winter session field practice (internship) semester with Hanwha Aerospace from 28 December 2026 to 28 January 2027. Eligible students must register with the department office and the Hanwha recruitment system between 15 and 19 October 2026, and the details may change when the programme is confirmed.
applies_to: Interested students majoring in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Industrial Engineering who are in their third year or above (priority is given to students expected to graduate in February or August 2027) and who hold an official English score from TOEIC Speaking or OPIc only, valid as of the document submission deadline (planned for Monday 19 October).

dates.what: Internship period (Field Practice 3, at least 150 hours)
Document submission deadline (planned); language scores must be valid as of this date
Course registration: submit the application form to the department office and documents to the Hanwha recruitment system
Practical interview (one day within this period, planned at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul site)
dates.when: One day between Wednesday 4 November 2026 and Friday 6 November 2026

dates.what: Background check result confirmation and pre-employment medical examination

steps: Check that you meet the requirements: an eligible major, third year or above, and a TOEIC Speaking or OPIc score that is valid as of the document submission deadline (planned for Monday 19 October).

Between Thursday 15 October and Monday 19 October 2026, submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office, and at the same time submit your documents through the Hanwha recruitment system. Both submissions are mandatory.
Attend the practical interview on one day between Wednesday 4 and Friday 6 November 2026. It is planned to take place at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul site.
If you are selected at the final selection (planned for Friday 20 November 2026), pay the tuition fee by Monday 23 November.
During December, complete the background check result confirmation and the pre-employment medical examination.
Complete the internship from 28 December 2026 to 28 January 2027 (at least 150 hours).
translation:
The Department of Aerospace Engineering plans to run a Winter Session Field Practice Semester for the 2026 academic year.

Interested students should check the schedule, eligibility requirements and other details below in advance.
(Please note that the programme is only planned at this stage, so the details may change when it is confirmed.)

1. Host organisation: Hanwha Aerospace (recruitment-linked)

2. Internship period: 28 December 2026 – 28 January 2027 (Field Practice 3 [현장실습 3] / at least 150 hours)

3. Student requirements
- Major: Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering
- Year: third year or above (priority is given to students expected to graduate in February or August 2027)
- An official language test score is required (TOEIC Speaking or OPIc only). *Only scores that are valid as of the document submission deadline (planned for Monday 19 October) will be accepted.

4. Planned number of positions
Organisation | Job category | Job sub-category | Work location | Number of positions
- Aeronautics Business Division [항공사업부] | R&D | Materials [재료/소재] | Pangyo | 2–3
- LS Business Division [LS사업부] | R&D | Mechanical/Aerospace [기계/항공] | Changwon | 2–3
  Electrical/Electronics [전기/전자] | 2–3
- PGM Business Division [PGM사업부] | R&D | Mechanical/Aerospace [기계/항공] | Daejeon | 2–3
  Electrical/Electronics [전기/전자] | 2–3
  SW/Computer [SW/컴퓨터] | 2–3
(The table is reproduced as it appears in the notice; the sub-category rows are listed under the division above them.)

5. Schedule
- Course registration: Thursday 15 October 2026 – Monday 19 October 2026
  * You must submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office AND, at the same time, submit your documents through the Hanwha recruitment system.
- Practical interview: one day between Wednesday 4 November 2026 and Friday 6 November 2026
  * Planned to take place at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul site.
- Final selection: Friday 20 November 2026 (planned)
  * Selected students must pay the tuition fee by Monday 23 November.
- Background check result confirmation and pre-employment medical examination: during December
  * As a defence company, Hanwha Aerospace includes a background check in its selection process as required by law.

6. Contact: Department of Aerospace Engineering office. The staff member's name, email address and phone number are given in the original notice.
